mapper.select: select concat(t.month_key, '|', t.user_name) as name, t.amount as value from ( select DATE_FORMAT(tt.deal_time, '%Y-%m') as month_key, ifnull(max(u.name), '未知') as user_name, ifnull(sum(tt.money), 0) as amount from t_tran tt left join t_user u on tt.create_by = u.id where tt.deal_time is not null and tt.deal_time >= #{startTime} group by DATE_FORMAT(tt.deal_time, '%Y-%m'), tt.create_by ) t order by name

select ifnull(u.name, '未知') as name, ifnull(sum(tt.money), 0) as value from t_tran tt left join t_user u on tt.create_by = u.id where year(tt.deal_time) = #{year} and month(tt.deal_time) = #{month} group by tt.create_by, u.name having value > 0 order by value desc

select ifnull(u.name, '未知') as name, ifnull(sum(tt.money), 0) as value from t_tran tt left join t_user u on tt.create_by = u.id where year(tt.deal_time) = #{year} group by tt.create_by, u.name having value > 0 order by value desc
select count(1) from t_clue tc where 1=1
select count(1) from t_clue tc where tc.clue_status in ('已联系', '已转客户')
select count(1) from t_clue tc where tc.clue_status = '已转客户'
select distinct source from t_customer where source is not null and source != '' order by source
select distinct course_type from t_customer where course_type is not null and course_type != '' order by course_type
select distinct source from t_clue where source is not null and source != '' order by source
select distinct intention_course from t_clue where intention_course is not null and intention_course != '' order by intention_course
